caption: A pigeon flies in and lands on a park railing.

sa.check: A pigeon flies in toward a railing.
The flight comes first and the landing follows.

pc.expect: It flares its wings to slow, extends its legs, and grips the rail; it does not stop dead in mid-air.
pc.fail: It stops dead in the air and drops; or lands before reaching the rail; or passes through the rail.

pc.expect: Its wings flap and fold at the joints, its legs extend, and it keeps two wings and two legs.
pc.fail: A wing detaches; or the wings bend like rubber along the feathers; or a third leg appears.

pc.expect: Once landed it stays on the rail.
pc.fail: It hovers above the rail without flapping; or rises after landing without flapping; or sinks through the rail.

pc.expect: Its feet grip the top of the rail.
pc.fail: Its feet pass through the rail; or the rail passes through the bird; or it sits inside the rail.

pc.expect: One pigeon keeps its shape and stays one bird.
pc.fail: It splits into two; or merges with the rail; or turns into another bird.

pc.expect: The pigeon's plumage and the railing stay the same.
pc.fail: The plumage changes colour; or the railing changes; or the park rearranges.

note: The pigeon is self-driven: its approach and timing are its own. Only the body's integrity and the landing are judged.
